data.notes: The report gets the core story right. It scopes the win to online memberships with the front desk still on Global, surfaces the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction, and correctly identifies own-file failed-payment recovery as the value proof that unlocked the controller. It falls short in two places. The language section marks covered:false but lists Maya's phrases without saying they are incidental and without noting the rep deferred to Slack. The rep takeaway omits the key theme that the front desk is a live, open deal rather than a done one (and slightly overstates that 'unified commerce' nearly lost the room).
